"""Write the three lengthwise brush strokes of the running-script exemplar."""
import json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline,PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
ROOT=Path('/app/output')

def build_samples(p,speed=12.):
    t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1)+np.abs(np.diff(p[:,2]))*.4)]
    ts=np.linspace(0,t[-1],int(np.ceil(t[-1]/(speed/20)))+1)
    return np.c_[CubicSpline(t,p[:,:2],bc_type='natural')(ts),PchipInterpolator(t,p[:,2])(ts)]

def generate(pathfile='fitted.json',name='trajectory',score=True):
    paths=[np.array(p) for p in json.load(open(ROOT/pathfile))]
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.065],speed=.08,settle=5)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.024],speed=.025,settle=8)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.04,settle=4)
    for i,knots in enumerate(paths):
        if i:
            # Re-dipping gathers the hairs for a reproducible entry.
            p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.1,settle=3)
            p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.024],speed=.03,settle=5)
            p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.04,settle=3)
        a=build_samples(knots)
        d=a[1,:2]-a[0,:2];d/=np.linalg.norm(d)
        before=a[0,:2]-d*4
        wx,wy=s.geo.mm_to_world(*before)
        p['move_tip']([wx,wy,.04],speed=.07,settle=5)
        p['move_tip']([wx,wy,.021],speed=.015,settle=5)
        wx,wy=s.geo.mm_to_world(*a[0,:2])
        p['move_tip']([wx,wy,.021],speed=.008,settle=3)
        p['move_tip']([wx,wy,.020-a[0,2]/1000],speed=.006,settle=4)
        for X,Y,depth in a[1:]:
            wx,wy=s.geo.mm_to_world(X,Y)
            q,ok,err=s.ik([wx,wy,.020-depth/1000])
            if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('IK',i,err))
            s.step(q)
        p['hold'](4)
        p['move_tip']([wx,wy,.04],speed=.008,settle=5)
        print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,flush=True)
    p['hold'](10)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,ROOT/(name+'.npz'))
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(ROOT/(name+'.png'))
    for i,st in enumerate(s.strokes()):
        if st['sheet']=='main':np.save(ROOT/(name+f'_samples{i}.npy'),st['samples'])
    print('Saved',len(actions),'actions',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
    if score:
        m=s.status();json.dump(m,open(ROOT/(name+'_metrics.json'),'w'),indent=2);print(json.dumps(m,indent=2),flush=True)
    return s,actions
if __name__=='__main__':generate(*(sys.argv[1:]))
